notice.title: Notifying customers of payment outages
notice.aiSummary: Payment service providers serving consumers must post a notice in their app and on their website within 1 hour of any outage that prevents customers from making payments. Firms must comply starting February 1, 2027.

text:
PAYMENTS OVERSIGHT COUNCIL FICTIONAL REGULATOR - SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE
Final rule: Notifying customers of payment outages
Notice number: RCN-2026-024
Issued by: Payments Oversight Council
Published: 2026-11-13
Effective date: 2027-02-01
1. Who this applies to
Payment service providers serving consumers.
2. Background
Customers need to know quickly when they cannot make payments, so they can use another way to pay.
3. Requirements
3.1 A firm must post a notice in its app and on its website within 1 hour of an outage that prevents customers from making payments.
4. Status
Firms must comply with the requirements in section 3 from 2027-02-01.

obligations.text: A firm must post a notice in its app and on its website within 1 hour of an outage that prevents customers from making payments.
obligations.controlDesc: Outage communication timestamps compared with outage start time after every payment outage
obligations.reason: Policy POL-RES-03 requires Payments Operations to post a status message in the mobile app and on the website within 1 hour when customers cannot make payments, exactly matching the obligation's 1-hour deadline and scope, and Control CTL-143 verifies outage communication timestamps against outage start time after every payment outage, which would detect breaches of this specific obligation.
